content: The authors would like to acknowledge Kai-ou Tang and William Labadie-Moseley for assistance in the development of a graphical user interface for text annotation. We would also like to thank Philips Healthcare, The Laboratory of Computational Physiology at The Massachusetts Institute of Technology, and staff at the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston, for supporting the MIMIC-III database, from which these data were derived.
